emerging_technology: Agentic AI systems: an integrated language model, model-selected tools, observations, permissions and human stopping authority for bounded multi-step digital work. This is the system under analysis, not a single model, chart plugin or all of generative AI.
intended_application: A proposed human-supervised chart-review workflow: compare business charts and claims with approved source tables using read-only tools, then draft corrections for a named human reviewer. No autonomous publication or financial/customer decisions.
business_need: Investigate whether review effort can be reduced while maintaining source traceability and correct interpretation.
management_question: How far have the defined technology and chart-review application diffused, what most accelerates or inhibits spread, and what timing implication follows for this organization without making the final adoption decision?
time_horizon: Four weeks for authorized evidence gathering; reassess timing over twelve months. No claimed deployment deadline or market takeoff forecast.
additional_context:

HYPOTHETICAL POSITIVE CONTROL H1, not real research: a closed study cohort consists of five eligible comparable finance firms using the exact defined chart-review task. A hypothetical audit on 2026-10-27 finds three have sustained weekly use for six months and two have not. All five statuses are known. This is a stipulated complete cohort, not a random sample of the sector. Quality/cost outcomes remain absent.
organization: Hypothetical mid-sized United States financial-services firm
industry_sector: Regulated financial services and internal management reporting.
users_stakeholders: Business analysts, analytics managers, model-risk staff, compliance reviewers, information-security staff, executives who consume reports, and customers indirectly affected by management decisions.
adoption_posture: Conservative and risk-averse. The firm permits bounded pilots but requires evidence of reliability, access control, auditability, and named human decision ownership before broader adoption.
capabilities_constraints: Established BI tables and experienced analysts. Sensitive data and legacy systems; no approved external model environment. Only public or synthetic material may be used before authorization. Named report ownership and human sign-off are required. No agent-specific validation dataset is supplied.
risk_consequence_context: A fabricated claim, incorrect denominator, privacy breach, or misleading visual could affect executive decisions, regulatory obligations, and reputation. Drafts are reversible, but distribution of an incorrect report can have material consequences.
